# Comparison of transformations for single-cell RNA-seq data

## Takeaway

The transformation is part of the statistical model: log1p-CPM, shifted log and residual-style transforms can change distances, variance structure and downstream embeddings. Use the R panel in the methods catalog to compare choices on the intended assay.

## Input and output

- Input: integer gene × cell counts with documented library sizes.
- Output: transformed matrix plus PCA-ready features and a method label.
- Record: filtering, size-factor rule, transform parameters and the downstream model.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01814-1
- Reproducibility archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7504146
- Turnkey entry: R/01_single_cell_transformations.R in the methods catalog.

## Limitation

This entry is a transparent baseline panel, not a claim that one transform is universally optimal. Confirm performance with the biological replicate structure and the actual downstream task.
